scope: Native Chromium Enter/Escape/Space repeat, focus return and browser UI transitions. Not Unity or physical-device certification.

checks.name: Help click/Escape returns focus to help; held Escape cannot also resume the battle
Retreat cancellation returns focus to its trigger; a fresh press can reopen and explicit confirmation still works
Held Enter changes a pause switch once and cannot reopen pause after resuming; fresh presses work
Held Space activates its modal button once on release and remains usable on the next press
Held Escape cancels only resonance confirmation; held Enter cannot reopen it or consume fragments twice
A navigation press cannot activate the next screen, while ordinary level-up keyboard repeat stays unchanged
